result.summary: Found two issues: low-contrast navigation and search text, and a misleading discount badge.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom-navigation labels and icons have low contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray text and icons to meet applicable contrast requirements.

issues.description: The pizza card displays a “−0%” discount badge, which suggests a promotion where there is no discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero, or display the correct discount.
